name: Rwanda (1961–2001)
description: Three equal vertical stripes of red, yellow and green with a black letter 'R' on the yellow stripe.
history: The pan-African tricolour was adopted after the coup of Gitarama on 28 January 1961, which abolished the Tutsi monarchy; because it was identical to the flag of Guinea a black 'R' was added in September 1961. Associated with the regime under which the 1994 genocide took place, it was replaced by the present blue, yellow and green flag on 31 December 2001.
